tweets: Pushkar, Rajasthan — home to one of India's very few temples dedicated to Brahma the creator. Legend holds its lake sprang from a lotus (puṣkara) he dropped from the sky; the town takes its name from that flower. Jagatpita Brahma Mandir, present shrine c. 14th century.
